data.description: The Twister Three Way is a standing waist twister for three people, with orange footplates around a central handle wheel. Each user stands on a plate, holds the wheel and turns the hips from side to side. With three stations on one post, it handles the morning rush on a busy park track and lets small groups exercise together. It complements the Seating Twister Three Way, which is the seated version for users who prefer to sit. The three-way twister sits in our Fun Fitness range with a Play Orange finish. Neither the size nor a warranty line is listed. For the Twister Three Way, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in the quote.

items.pText: The Twister Three Way is a standing waist twister for three people, with orange footplates around a central handle wheel. Each user stands on a plate, holds the wheel and turns the hips from side to side. With three stations on one post, it handles the morning rush on a busy park track and lets small groups exercise together. It complements the Seating Twister Three Way, which is the seated version for users who prefer to sit. The three-way twister sits in our Fun Fitness range with a Play Orange finish. Neither the size nor a warranty line is listed. For the Twister Three Way, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in the quote.

Three footplates share one post, so the base should be grouted on most grounds. Each plate has its own bearing to check and grease. Leave a clear ring around the machine so people waiting do not stand where a turning plate can catch them.
